name: local-meeting-notes
description: Ember: private meeting recorder, live call assistant, speech-to-text, clipboard and web saving app
author: Lucas Synnott

scripts.dist: npm run build:renderer && npm run build:worker && npm run build:zoom-observer && npm run build:hotkey && npm run build:calendar && npm run build:extract && npm run build:screens && npm run build:grab && npm run build:record && npm run build:drive && electron-builder --mac --publish never
scripts.test: node --test "test/**/*.test.js" && cd renderer && bun test src/
scripts.dist:dir: npm run build:renderer && npm run build:worker && npm run build:zoom-observer && npm run build:hotkey && npm run build:calendar && npm run build:extract && npm run build:screens && npm run build:grab && npm run build:record && npm run build:drive && electron-builder --mac dir
scripts.build:hotkey: swiftc -O -framework AppKit -framework ApplicationServices -framework Carbon native/hotkey/main.swift -o native/hotkey/meeting-notes-hotkey
scripts.build:renderer: cd renderer && bun install --frozen-lockfile && bun run build
scripts.build:record: swiftc -O -framework ScreenCaptureKit -framework AVFoundation -framework CoreMedia -framework CoreImage -framework AppKit native/record/main.swift native/record/export.swift -o native/record/meeting-notes-record
scripts.build:screens: swiftc -O -framework ScreenCaptureKit -framework Vision -framework AppKit native/screens/main.swift -o native/screens/meeting-notes-screens
scripts.dist:win: npm run build:renderer && npm run build:worker && npm run build:windows-native && npm run setup:windows-media && npm run setup:windows-ai && npm run setup:windows-whisper && npm run build:windows-composio && electron-builder --win --x64 --publish never
scripts.dist:win:dir: npm run build:renderer && npm run build:worker && npm run build:windows-native && npm run setup:windows-media && npm run setup:windows-ai && npm run setup:windows-whisper && npm run build:windows-composio && electron-builder --win dir --x64 --publish never

extendInfo.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Ember records your selected microphone during meetings and screen recordings.
extendInfo.NSCameraUsageDescription: Ember shows your camera in a bubble on your screen recordings.
extendInfo.NSAppleEventsUsageDescription: Ember reads the address of the page open in your browser when you press the Save link shortcut.
extendInfo.NSAudioCaptureUsageDescription: Ember records system and voice-chat audio for your private meeting notes.
extendInfo.NSScreenCaptureUsageDescription: Ember records your screen when you make a screen recording, and uses screen capture to record system and voice-chat audio.
extendInfo.NSCalendarsFullAccessUsageDescription: Ember names your calls after their calendar event and lists who was invited.
extendInfo.NSCalendarsUsageDescription: Ember names your calls after their calendar event and lists who was invited.
extendInfo.NSRemindersFullAccessUsageDescription: Ember adds your action items to Reminders when you send them there.
extendInfo.NSRemindersUsageDescription: Ember adds your action items to Reminders when you send them there.
